content.text: Skip to main content Full Time Full Time Clip: Zaha, Westwood Deliver In Charlotte’s 2-1 Win Ryan Disdier Saturday, Apr 4, 2026, 08:55 PM Copy URL Share on Facebook Share on X A heavy downpour of rain didn’t stand in the way of Charlotte FC earning a second consecutive victory at home, as The Crown defeated Philadelphia Union 2-1 in thrilling fashion. MLS Regular SeasonSaturday April 4 FinalCLT21PHIMatch Details A stellar strike from Charlotte captain Ashley Westwood in the 30th minute gave the hosts their initial lead. Pep Biel initiated the chance, delivering a precise pass inside the box. Westwood then capitalized and slotted the ball well past Philadelphia’s goalkeeper. GOAL!
